idea-plugin.name: Testcontainers Data Sources
idea-plugin.description:
Automatically registers Database tool window data sources for databases started by Testcontainers.

When a Testcontainers-managed container (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, Redis, MongoDB) starts, the plugin reads its published port and credentials from Docker and creates a ready-to-use data source. When the container is removed (Ryuk cleanup), the data source is removed too.

Requires docker CLI in PATH. Settings: Settings | Tools | Testcontainers Data Sources.
